scope: Offline review layout only; no scene activation or full runtime/hardware qualification.

coordinateContract.anchors: Current source FLOOR_PLAN_SCALE and actual exterior builders; no copied coordinates.

counts.scope: Complete review arrays, including existing ground walls/nav and exterior solids. Dynamic doors, furnishings and stair guards are not a full live runtime capture.

qualification.note: Movement uses current radius, run speed, subdivision and X-then-Z occupancy order.

coordinateContract.planAnchors: Source position X/Z; multiply by plan scale exactly once.
coordinateContract.localDimensions: Builder geometry is already in world metres; no plan conversion.
coordinateContract.worldSolids: Declared collider rectangles; distinct from measured mesh bounds.
coordinateContract.padding: Signed collider margin against source-owned solids; decorative parts excluded. Multi-solid sources select intersecting parts per rectangle.

cpu.method: 128 collision and 128 nav miss queries per batch, 50 warm batches, 3 x 100 samples.
cpu.arrays: Actual complete review arrays, no truncation or per-lot broadphase.

remainingGates: Existing sidewalk end walls block both home connections; retained without runtime edits.
Global arrays exceed provisional query targets; engine expansion not attempted.
No rendering/FPS, low-end hardware, normal-scene traversal or visual production acceptance.
